text: We received an allegation that the Corporate Real Estate Management (CREM) Division (formerly Facilities Management) was paying inaccurate or inflated invoices. We conducted a review of billing accuracy and contract management processes. While we did find some billing errors and invoice processing issues, intentional overbilling was not noted. We also identified areas of procurement and contract management processes for CREM to improve. We note that CREM is transforming how it is managing vendors and is already moving forward on some invoice processing improvements. Our findings and recommendations will help CREM as it continues to improve how it procures services, manages contracts, and pays invoices going forward.
